2C.4 The eye of the LORD is on those who fear Him.

precepts.text: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear Him, upon them that hope in His mercy; our soul waiteth for the Lord, for He is our help and our shield. The Most High is the help and shield David is leaning on.
precepts.point: But thou O Lord art a shield for me, my glory, and the lifter up of mine head. Think about it: your grown son gets big and bad and comes against you, yet David still trusted in the Most High.

note.label: Psalm 3: But Thou O Lord Art a Shield for Me

precepts.why:
“Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God.” David did not agree; he was a man after the Most High's own heart and trusted in Him: “Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy; To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.”

“Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield. For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name. Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.” The Most High is the help and shield David is leaning on when he says, “But thou, O Lord, art a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.”

Think about it: your grown son gets big and bad and comes against you, and the men turn away, yet David still trusted in the Most High, whose eye is upon them that fear him and hope in his mercy.

precepts.text: Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness and gladness of heart, therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies, which is who our people serve now, even on Sundays when they think they are serving the Most High but are serving the man that put us into captivity and stole the identity of the black Messiah.
precepts.point: It is the righteous that must rejoice in the Lord, us that understand who the Most High is, that He is a black man according to the Bible, that His son is black, and that the Israelites are black. This is how we rejoice in the Lord, not to Cesare Borgia. Praise the Lord with harp, sing unto Him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings, sing unto Him a new song, play skillfully with a loud noise.

note.label: Psalm 33: Rejoice in the Lord O Ye Righteous

precepts.why:
“Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.” Comely means beautiful. We must remember to rejoice, because that is why we came into captivity in the first place: “Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things”. Therefore we were made to serve our enemies, which is who our people serve now, even on Sundays when they think they are serving the Most High. They are serving the man that put us into captivity and stole the identity of the black Messiah.

Our people do have a spirit to rejoice in the Lord, but they are not rejoicing to him in church on Sunday; they are rejoicing to Cesare Borgia. The spirit within them to serve is a godly spirit, because we are of God, but they are not serving him in spirit and in truth, because they have no idea who the Most High is.

It is the righteous that must rejoice in the Lord: us that understand who the Most High is, that he is a black man according to the Bible, that his son is black, and that the Israelites are black. That is how we rejoice in the Lord, with the harp, the psaltery and the instrument of ten strings, a new song played skilfully with a loud noise, and not to Cesare Borgia.

precepts.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and a good understanding have all they that do His commandments, so if you are not keeping the commandments you have no wisdom or understanding.
precepts.point: To deliver their soul from death and to keep them alive in famine. Our soul waited for the Lord, He is our help and our shield, for our heart shall rejoice in Him because we have trusted in His holy name.

note.label: Psalm 33: Rejoice in the Lord O Ye Righteous

precepts.why:
“Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy”. What is it to fear him? “The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments”. Fearing God means you are going to keep the commandments; so if you are keeping the commandments, the eyes of the Lord are upon you. And if you are not keeping the commandments, you have no wisdom or understanding.

This is a heavy psalm. He “beholdeth all the sons of men” and “considereth all their works”, so we need to watch what we do and how we move out here in society. Just because we are not with another brother or sister does not mean we can sneak off and do evil and it will not come up. It will come up.

His eye is on them that fear him “To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.” He is our help and our shield, and our heart rejoices in him because we have trusted in his holy name.

precepts.text: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
precepts.point: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

note.label: John 1: The Word, the Witness of John, and the King of Israel

precepts.why: “All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.” The Word is Christ, and the psalm shows the word making everything: “By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.” The heavens and all the host of them were made by the word of the Lord, so nothing that was made was made without him.

points: For the word of the Lord is right and all His works are done in truth, He loveth righteousness and judgment, the earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

points: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made and all the host of them by the breath of His mouth, He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap and layeth up the deep in storehouses.

note.label: Psalm 33: Rejoice in the Lord O Ye Righteous

points: Let all the earth fear the Lord, let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him, for He spake and it was done, He commanded and it stood fast.

note.label: Psalm 33: Rejoice in the Lord O Ye Righteous

points: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought and maketh the devices of the people of none effect. We have to take that into consideration in this time of pandemic where the vaccination of information is floating around and there is fake news everywhere.

Even though they plot against us and set traps for the nation of Israel as we push this truth throughout the four corners of the earth, even though they will cross heaven and earth to stop the rise of the nation of Israel, the Most High brings the counsel of the wicked to nought. We ought to ask the Most High in our prayers to bring their devices to an end. Do not worry about the vaccine, whether you take it or not is up to you, but the counsel of the ungodly will have no effect on us who are keeping the commandments, for we are under His will and under His wings.

note.label: Psalm 33: Rejoice in the Lord O Ye Righteous

points: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of His heart to all generations. The people whom He hath chosen for His own inheritance, and there are thousands of precepts on who that is.
